summary_ja: 推計誤差を考慮した保守的な修正を定める。
summary_en: Requires estimates of PD, LGD and EAD to be adjusted conservatively to allow for expected estimation error.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach shall conservatively adjust its estimates of PD, LGD and EAD, taking into account that errors are expected to arise in the estimates.
